primitive.relation: Pointwise equality of adjacency with del_es_rel G [set e] for every vertex set e, valid edge or not (GTBase.common.del_edge_set1); the deleted graphs are related by the identity isomorphism. Specialization of the edge-set-deletion family at F = [set e].

upstream_audit.note: Upstream sgraph.del_edges e deletes every edge inside the vertex set e. It agrees with single-pair deletion only when #|e| <= 2, and deletes more for larger e, so it is not the canonical. del_edge_set G [set e] removes exactly the pair e and is a no-op for invalid e (empty, singleton, three or more vertices: del_edge_set1_invalid). Host-side isomorphism invariance of induced copies and of induced_free (induced_copy_host_diso, induced_free_host_diso) composes upstream isubgraph_comp, induced_isubgraph and isubgraph_induced.
